## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Berlin, Germany. It starts at 185 Friedrichstraße.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Join a unique Spree boat tour in Berlin. Expect surprises like a whale appearing suddenly, a shrinking machine that makes you smaller, and close encounters with not one but two dinosaurs.
>
> Escape last minute from a fire-breathing Godzilla with a helicopter. This combination of reality and special effects will leave you questioning what's real. Capture it all on your smartphone as the lines between reality and fantasy blur.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €17.50. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 22 ratings and 14 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
